people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

translations.web: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of them. They are wholly carried away captive.
translations.bsb: The cities of the Negev have been shut tight, and no one can open them. All Judah has been carried into exile, wholly taken captive.
translations.kjv: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
translations.asv: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is none to open them: Judah is carried away captive, all of it; it is wholly carried away captive.
